AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production ? (1 mark)

   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)

   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene? (1 mark)

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Trees? (1 mark)

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
